notes: Original exact morality-versus-amnesia pairwise test statistic and group-specific analytic sample sizes were not printed. The original planned contrast F(1,146) = 6.94, p = .009 combines memories or desires and is not substituted for the requested pairwise comparison. Original p < .01 comes from the explicit all-pairwise-comparisons caption with named exceptions, neither of which is this target. Original study-wide N = 148 is contextual only, not asserted as the pairwise analytic n. Replication Table 16 reports Cohen’s ds as printed, and Tukey-adjusted p for the same row. Table 15 supplies the two relevant condition sample sizes; no sum or effect-size conversion was calculated. The acquired OSF manuscript title matches the supplied reference, with authors listed Wong then Feldman. Replication Table 22 repeats the original combined-contrast effect against both morality-amnesia and morality-apathy; this was not used as an independently printed original pairwise statistic.
